Open Innovation Design Crit

Running Order

  • Intro to Design Crit (GDS STyle)
  • Show Crit Canvas
  • Set Context
  • Show your stuff
  • Question session
  • Split into groups and develop feedback
  • Reconvene and deliver some feedback highlights
  • Respectful Dissent if time allows
